g.text: Criminal coders earn about what honest ones do in emerging

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #121212

g.text: economies, a tenth of what American AI engineers make
Band: median pay offered in dark-web IT job ads, 2020-22, from designers ($16k) to reverse engineers ($48k); Kaspersky, which
collected them, found no significant difference from legitimate pay. Elsewhere: latest medians, except averages for Brazil (formal
contracts) and the IT sector in Belarus and China (private to state employers). *Take-home pay; others before tax. US: BLS median
salary; Levels.fyi median total pay, including stock. Crime pay is salary; the few who share in ransoms earn far more. Not adjusted
Sources: Krebs on Security (Conti leaks); Kaspersky (155 dark-web forums); US Department of Justice; Habr Career; DOU; Belstat;
China's National Bureau of Statistics; Brasscom; ITviec; Kolesa Group; US Bureau of Labor Statistics; Levels.fyi
Dark-web IT job ads, 2020-22: median pay by role, $16k–48k
